raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
Fixes #43874

## Summary

Integrated-mode fixes for `python/sglang/multimodal_gen/apps/ComfyUI_SGLDiffusion/`, narrowed per review. Bug numbers match the issue.

- **Bug 1: GGUF unets could not be detected or loaded.** Detection now reads names and logical shapes from the GGUF header with `read_gguf_tensor_meta()` and runs ComfyUI's detection on them, like safetensors, so no BF16 companion file is needed. A GGUF picked in `SGLDUNETLoader` is loaded as the DiT. The GGUF loader maps tensor names through the spec's param mapping for both quant lookup and weight loading: Z-Image `qkv` -> `to_qkv`, `w1`/`w3` packed shards are concatenated into the fused `w13`, and packed tensors whose layer builds without GGUF (adaLN `ReplicatedLinear`) are dequantized on load.
- **Bug 2: `.gguf` leaked into ComfyUI's global `diffusion_models` registry.** `SGLDUNETLoader` now builds its own list with ComfyUI's `recursive_search` / `filter_files_extensions`, so the stock loader no longer offers GGUF files.
- **Bug 3: detection failure returned a bare `None`** ("cannot unpack non-iterable NoneType"). It now raises `ValueError` with the model path.
- **Bug 4: a missing runtime made every node vanish silently.** `executors/minimax_h3.py` guards its runtime imports like `base.py`, and `__init__.py` logs why registration failed.

Dropped from this PR: Cache-DiT (#43696), worker sleep/wake (#44086), server-mode items (#44082), and VRAM accounting (moved to #44086).

## Tests

Regression tests live in the existing unit files and reuse their fixtures (`test_comfyui_checkpoint_spec.py`, `test_comfyui_generator.py`, `test_comfyui_lora_node.py`); no new test file. Targeted CPU run: 52 passed.

ComfyUI v0.39.2 headless, 1x L40S, Z-Image Turbo, 1024x1024, 8 steps, seed 42:

| Path | Time | GPU mem used | vs native BF16 |
|---|---|---|---|
| Native ComfyUI BF16 | 2.87 s | - | - |
| SGLD BF16 | 2.79 s | 23.7 GB | 24.2 dB PSNR / 0.879 SSIM |
| SGLD `z-image-turbo-Q4_K_M.gguf` | 3.09 s | 14.7 GB | 14.2 dB PSNR / 0.431 SSIM |

The GGUF image keeps the same composition; the lower PSNR is Q4 drift in fine detail against a BF16 reference.

H3 GGUF: checked the real `minimax_h3_fl2va_pruned-Q4_K.gguf` header against the new name mapping; 0 of 532 tensor names change, so the H3 path loads as before.

- [ ] TODO: H3 GGUF end-to-end ComfyUI run still pending.

Known gap: Flux ComfyUI GGUF likely still needs its `_convert_weights` reshapes on the GGUF path; left as a follow-up.

nodes.body:
hi @niehen6174,

Planning to add support for a few minor features.

- **Video-to-video**: Add a VIDEO input and a denoise-strength control to the generic video node. /v1/videos already accepts video_path / video_reference, so this is for restyling and extending clips.
- **Generic audio-video node**: One node instead of one per model (H3, LTX-2, MOVA, Kandinsky-6). It takes an optional AUDIO input for lip-sync or music-driven video. It returns an AUDIO output that ComfyUI's audio nodes can use.
- **Prompt enhancement**: The server supports enhance_prompt. Return the rewritten prompt as a STRING so users can see, edit and reuse it.
- **Checkpoint sweep**: Uses /update_weights_from_disk to swap weights in place with no restart. It runs the same prompt and seed across step-500 to step-5000 and lays the results out as a grid.
- **LoRA browser and stacking**: Fill a dropdown from /v1/list_loras. Support several LoRAs with per-LoRA strength and merge mode. The current Set LoRA node takes one free-text path and has no strength control.
- **Workflow to API recipe**: Turns an SGLang-backed graph into a ready-to-run curl request, Python snippet, or sglang generate command with all parameters filled in.

Wanted to get your view on this.

Thank you!

Thanks for the audit, there are real fixes here. To keep it reviewable, could you narrow this PR to the integrated-mode fixes (#1, #2, #5, #8, and #12 if you want)?

- Please drop #4, since #43696 handles Cache-DiT per run.
- #13 sleep/wake is a feature rather than a fix, so let's leave it out for now.
- Please remove the server-mode items (#3, #6, #7, #9, #10, #11, #14) or move them to a separate PR. They're lower priority for us right now.

Thanks for narrowing it down. Bugs 2, 3 and 4 look good. Two changes:
- **Bug 1:** instead of filename hints and a BF16 companion table, could you read the GGUF header with `read_gguf_tensor_meta()` (`runtime/loader/gguf_weights.py`) and run ComfyUI's detection on those names and logical shapes, the same way we already do for safetensors? Then no companion file is needed.
- **Bug 5:** please move it to #44086. On its own it makes things worse: `loaded_size()` stays 0, so ComfyUI would try to free the full model size on every sampling run.

Tested the latest head on RTX 5090 with real ComfyUI workflows. BF16 and H3 GGUF both work, but Z-Image GGUF (`z-image-turbo-Q4_K_M.gguf`) still fails during loading:

`Linear layer 'noise_refiner.0.attention.to_qkv' has no weight in the GGUF checkpoint`

The checkpoint contains `noise_refiner.0.attention.qkv.weight`, while the quantized layer looks up `to_qkv.weight`. It looks like the raw GGUF tensor metadata isn't aligned with the runtime layer names.

Could you normalize the names consistently for both GGUF metadata lookup and weight loading, including packed QKV handling? Please also add a small regression test for this mapping and rerun Z-Image GGUF end to end, while keeping the working BF16 and H3 GGUF paths intact.

hi @niehen6174, thanks for testing. Fixed in the latest push.

The GGUF loader now maps tensor names through the spec mapping for both quant lookup and weight loading. For Z-Image, `qkv` maps to `to_qkv`, the packed `w1`/`w3` shards are concatenated into `w13`, and packed adaLN weights (plain `ReplicatedLinear`) are dequantized on load. Added a regression test for the mapping in `test_comfyui_checkpoint_spec.py`.

ComfyUI v0.39.2, 1x L40S, 1024x1024, 8 steps, seed 42:

| Path | Time | vs native BF16 |
|---|---|---|
| Native BF16 | 2.87 s | - |
| SGLD BF16 | 2.79 s | 24.2 dB / 0.879 SSIM |
| SGLD `z-image-turbo-Q4_K_M.gguf` | 3.09 s | 14.2 dB / 0.431 SSIM |

The GGUF image keeps the same composition; the gap is Q4 detail drift.

H3 GGUF: the new mapping leaves all 532 tensor names of `minimax_h3_fl2va_pruned-Q4_K.gguf` unchanged, so that path should load as before. TODO: H3 GGUF end-to-end run still pending on my side, would be great if you can recheck it on your setup.

+    """ComfyUI ships DiTs as one safetensors or GGUF file with no model_index.json."""
+    return os.path.isfile(model_path) and model_path.endswith((".safetensors", ".gguf"))
+
+
+def _gguf_runtime_layout(tensor_meta: dict, mapping: dict) -> tuple[dict, dict]:
+    """Key GGUF metadata by runtime names; return it with the fused-shard plan.
+
+    Shards of one fused runtime layer (Z-Image w1/w3 -> w13) keep their own
+    entries and are concatenated on load, under the fused name quant lookup uses.
+    """
+    from sglang.multimodal_gen.runtime.loader.gguf_weights import (
+        remap_gguf_tensor_meta,
+    )
+
+    map_name = get_param_names_mapping(mapping)
+    plain, fused = {}, defaultdict(dict)
+    for name, meta in tensor_meta.items():
+        target, index, _ = map_name(name)
+        if index is None:
+            plain[name] = meta
+        else:
+            fused[target][index] = (name, meta)
+
+    layout = remap_gguf_tensor_meta(plain, lambda name: map_name(name)[0])
+    shard_plan = {}
+    for target, parts in fused.items():
+        metas = [parts[i][1] for i in sorted(parts)]
+        first = metas[0]
+        if len({(m.ggml_type, m.is_packed, m.logical_shape[1:]) for m in metas}) > 1:
+            raise ValueError(f"GGUF shards of {target} differ in type or width")
+        param_name = (
+            f"{target.removesuffix('.weight')}.qweight" if first.is_packed else target
+        )
+        layout[target] = replace(
+            first,
+            logical_shape=(
+                sum(m.logical_shape[0] for m in metas),
+                *first.logical_shape[1:],
+            ),
+            stored_shape=(
+                sum(m.stored_shape[0] for m in metas),
+                *first.stored_shape[1:],
+            ),
+            param_name=param_name,
+        )
+        for index, (name, meta) in parts.items():
+            layout[name] = meta
+            shard_plan[meta.param_name] = (param_name, index, len(parts))
+    return layout, shard_plan

+def _runtime_gguf_weights(weights, layout: dict, shard_plan: dict, quant_config):
+    """Fuse planned shards; dequantize packed tensors whose layer built without
+    GGUF (e.g. Z-Image adaLN ReplicatedLinear). Runs after model construction,
+    so quant_config.selected is final."""
+    import gguf
+
+    packed_types = {m.param_name: m.weight_type for m in layout.values() if m.is_packed}
+    pending = defaultdict(dict)
+    for name, tensor in weights:
+        if name in shard_plan:
+            name, index, total = shard_plan[name]
+            pending[name][index] = tensor
+            if len(pending[name]) < total:
+                continue
+            parts = pending.pop(name)
+            tensor = torch.cat([parts[i] for i in range(total)])
+        prefix = name.removesuffix(".qweight")
+        if name in packed_types and prefix not in quant_config.selected:
+            value = gguf.dequantize(tensor.numpy(), packed_types[name])
+            name, tensor = f"{prefix}.weight", torch.from_numpy(value).bfloat16()
+        yield name, tensor

hi @niehen6174,

Planning to add support for a few minor features.

- **Video-to-video**: Add a VIDEO input and a denoise-strength control to the generic video node. /v1/videos already accepts video_path / video_reference, so this is for restyling and extending clips.
- **Generic audio-video node**: One node instead of one per model (H3, LTX-2, MOVA, Kandinsky-6). It takes an optional AUDIO input for lip-sync or music-driven video. It returns an AUDIO output that ComfyUI's audio nodes can use.
- **Prompt enhancement**: The server supports enhance_prompt. Return the rewritten prompt as a STRING so users can see, edit and reuse it.
- **Checkpoint sweep**: Uses /update_weights_from_disk to swap weights in place with no restart. It runs the same prompt and seed across step-500 to step-5000 and lays the results out as a grid.
- **LoRA browser and stacking**: Fill a dropdown from /v1/list_loras. Support several LoRAs with per-LoRA strength and merge mode. The current Set LoRA node takes one free-text path and has no strength control.
- **Workflow to API recipe**: Turns an SGLang-backed graph into a ready-to-run curl request, Python snippet, or sglang generate command with all parameters filled in.

Wanted to get your view on this.

Thank you!

Thanks for the audit, there are real fixes here. To keep it reviewable, could you narrow this PR to the integrated-mode fixes (#1, #2, #5, #8, and #12 if you want)?

- Please drop #4, since #43696 handles Cache-DiT per run.
- #13 sleep/wake is a feature rather than a fix, so let's leave it out for now.
- Please remove the server-mode items (#3, #6, #7, #9, #10, #11, #14) or move them to a separate PR. They're lower priority for us right now.

Thanks for narrowing it down. Bugs 2, 3 and 4 look good. Two changes:
- **Bug 1:** instead of filename hints and a BF16 companion table, could you read the GGUF header with `read_gguf_tensor_meta()` (`runtime/loader/gguf_weights.py`) and run ComfyUI's detection on those names and logical shapes, the same way we already do for safetensors? Then no companion file is needed.
- **Bug 5:** please move it to #44086. On its own it makes things worse: `loaded_size()` stays 0, so ComfyUI would try to free the full model size on every sampling run.

Tested the latest head on RTX 5090 with real ComfyUI workflows. BF16 and H3 GGUF both work, but Z-Image GGUF (`z-image-turbo-Q4_K_M.gguf`) still fails during loading:

`Linear layer 'noise_refiner.0.attention.to_qkv' has no weight in the GGUF checkpoint`

The checkpoint contains `noise_refiner.0.attention.qkv.weight`, while the quantized layer looks up `to_qkv.weight`. It looks like the raw GGUF tensor metadata isn't aligned with the runtime layer names.

Could you normalize the names consistently for both GGUF metadata lookup and weight loading, including packed QKV handling? Please also add a small regression test for this mapping and rerun Z-Image GGUF end to end, while keeping the working BF16 and H3 GGUF paths intact.

hi @niehen6174, thanks for testing. Fixed in the latest push.

The GGUF loader now maps tensor names through the spec mapping for both quant lookup and weight loading. For Z-Image, `qkv` maps to `to_qkv`, the packed `w1`/`w3` shards are concatenated into `w13`, and packed adaLN weights (plain `ReplicatedLinear`) are dequantized on load. Added a regression test for the mapping in `test_comfyui_checkpoint_spec.py`.

ComfyUI v0.39.2, 1x L40S, 1024x1024, 8 steps, seed 42:

| Path | Time | vs native BF16 |
|---|---|---|
| Native BF16 | 2.87 s | - |
| SGLD BF16 | 2.79 s | 24.2 dB / 0.879 SSIM |
| SGLD `z-image-turbo-Q4_K_M.gguf` | 3.09 s | 14.2 dB / 0.431 SSIM |

The GGUF image keeps the same composition; the gap is Q4 detail drift.

H3 GGUF: the new mapping leaves all 532 tensor names of `minimax_h3_fl2va_pruned-Q4_K.gguf` unchanged, so that path should load as before. TODO: H3 GGUF end-to-end run still pending on my side, would be great if you can recheck it on your setup.
